address: Palanga Life Balance SPA Hotel, Birutės av. 60, Palanga, 00135, Lithuania
bio: Chef Giorgio Pignagnoli brings plenty of Italian flair and creativity to the kitchen of this smartly dressed restaurant at the Palanga Spa Life Balance Hotel. There are often dishes to share on the menu, such as sole or chateaubriand, while standouts include his smoked eel risotto, which is as flavoursome as it is colourful. Many of the generously sized dishes come with his own original touches, but neither is he afraid of tradition – he uses his grandmother’s special recipe for his delicious tiramisu, for example.
